description: The tax-free first £30,000 of a redundancy payment, the income tax on the rest given the year's other income, and what is received. Use for 'how much tax on a £45k redundancy payment'.

otherIncome.description: Everything else taxable this tax year - salary, notice pay, holiday pay. Defaults to 0.

payment.description: Statutory plus any extra redundancy payment, in pounds.

scotland.description: Scottish income tax rates. Defaults to where they live, from Settings - false if not said.
